notes: Project-switch chrome measures nothing on the swap: a strip or sidebar whose rows change wholesale keys its presence boundary on a generation (no exit or enter springs, no layout snapshots, no shared-element glide from a chip that is gone) and glides again 400 ms later with a fresh layout id, never past 40 rows; chips take a per-row layoutDependency so unchanged re-renders skip snapshots; the sidebar virtualizer sizes a newly mounted row from its cache or estimate and lets the ResizeObserver correct it instead of reading a rect per row before the paint; tab-group records parse from localStorage once and refresh on write or a storage event
